steps.note: Open the single-stage creation flow for an auction.
a priced single-stage event needs its type set before a template (the screen opens as RFP)
Apply the first available auction template.
Create multiple line items so the vendor can be prompted for a breakdown across them.
Commit the auction submission window so it can end naturally.
Invite the QA vendor that will submit the total bid.
Confirm the auction reached a published project page.
Confirm the vendor's bid was accepted.
Return to the buyer console before waiting for the auction to end.
Wait for the auction submission time to end rather than force-ending it.
Inspect the vendor session after the submission window closes.
Open the ended auction's pricing round in the vendor portal.
Verify that the vendor portal shows the Cost Breakdown Time has begun.
Verify that the vendor is presented with line-item pricing fields for the breakdown.
